fixtureCorpus.text: For a conductor at constant temperature, V = IR. V is potential difference in volts, I current in amperes, R resistance in ohms. Doubling V doubles I for unchanged R.

fixtureCorpus.label: SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE - never production retrieval
fixtureCorpus.text: During evaporation, molecules with higher kinetic energy leave a liquid surface. Energy is taken from the remaining liquid, which cools. Evaporation can occur below boiling temperature.

fixtureCorpus.label: SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE - never production retrieval
fixtureCorpus.text: Mitochondria participate in aerobic respiration and supply energy used in cellular activities.

fixtureCorpus.label: SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE - never production retrieval
fixtureCorpus.text: Mitosis produces two daughter cells with the same chromosome number as the parent. Meiosis halves the chromosome number to form reproductive cells.

fixtureCorpus.label: SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE - never production retrieval
fixtureCorpus.text: Plants respire. Living plant cells use respiration to release energy; photosynthesis is a separate process.

fixtureCorpus.label: SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE - never production retrieval
fixtureCorpus.text: H2O represents water. NaCl represents sodium chloride. Na+ and Ca2+ are ions with different positive charges.

fixtureCorpus.label: SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE - never production retrieval
fixtureCorpus.text: A bar magnet has north and south poles. Like poles repel; unlike poles attract. A magnetic field describes the region in which magnetic forces act.
